title: Bombardment
description:
Deal 18 damage.
At the start of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it.
upgraded_description:
Deal 24 damage.
At the start of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it.
notes: Automatically plays from the Exhaust Pile at the start of the player's turn, preventing double-triggering from other auto-play phase effects.
